title: Lamb Harira Naan
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired lamb dish served with a twist on traditional Moroccan naan, all in one delicious and easy-to-make package.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the yogurt, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it, and let it rise for 1 hour.
While the dough is rising, heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, and caraway seeds to the skillet.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 minutes until the onion is softened.
Add the ground lamb to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 minutes until the lamb is fully cooked.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on how large you want your naan to be.
Roll out each piece of dough into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place a naan in the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it is puffed and golden.
Repeat with the remaining dough, serving the naan hot with the lamb harira.
